question: When did the VLDB Foundation and SIGMOD start the DBCares initiative, and what role did H. V. Jagadish have during Volume 7 and in founding the DBCares initiative?
prompt: When did the VLDB Foundation and SIGMOD start the DBCares initiative, and what role did H. V. Jagadish have during Volume 7 and in founding the DBCares initiative?
expected_answer: October 2018; H. V. Jagadish was the Founding Editor-in-Chief of PVLDB.
final_answer: The VLDB Foundation and SIGMOD started the DBCares initiative in Volume 7, which was edited by H. V. Jagadish and Aoying Zhou. H. V. Jagadish served as the Founding Editor-in-Chief of Volume 7 and was also one of the Editors-in-Chief for several issues in that volume. Additionally, he played a role in founding the DBCares initiative.
